statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the requested alias, its canonical redirect page, and the primary outbound hand-off.

page.notes: blacktoon414.com redirects to blacktoonurl.net. The canonical page is a single static Korean link hub; there are no same-site content templates or forms.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared default and emulated dark screenshots and computed color-scheme.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark and default captures are identical; colorScheme is normal and fixed white cards do not retint.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated reduced motion and inspected active animations and CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No active animations were present, and Bootstrap transition rules include prefers-reduced-motion overrides.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured at prefers-contrast:more and visually checked controls and text.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All text and controls remain present and distinguishable in the high-contrast preference capture.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected routes, DOM, and view-transition CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This single static page has no same-document or same-origin state/route transition; its destinations are external and open in new tabs.
checkOutcomes.reason: This single static page has no same-document or same-origin state/route transition; its destinations are external and open in new tabs.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and rendered behavior for scroll-linked effects.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no parallax, scrollytelling, carousel, or scroll-linked animation to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page has no parallax, scrollytelling, carousel, or scroll-linked animation to implement.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected interactive DOM and CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All interaction uses native anchors and normal document scrolling; there are no custom pointer handlers or platform-fighting gestures.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected page chrome and scrolling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: There is no sticky or affixed navigation chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no sticky or affixed navigation chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM for overlays, menus, popovers, and dialogs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no tooltip, popover, menu, or anchored overlay.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page has no tooltip, popover, menu, or anchored overlay.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop/mobile visual hierarchy and native link flow.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A linear card list and strong full-width buttons clearly guide attention to each destination without focus being moved to injected content.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed load screenshots and overlay DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No popup, banner, consent wall, or interstitial obscures content on load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM for rich controls and overlays.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No disclosure, modal, picker, select, or transient overlay is present, so no dismissible primitive is needed.
checkOutcomes.reason: No disclosure, modal, picker, select, or transient overlay is present, so no dismissible primitive is needed.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop and mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page uses a content-first single column with minimal global chrome and no persistent application frame.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured mobile and desktop layout.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360 px, scrollWidth equals clientWidth (360 px), horizontal overflow is 0, and viewport metadata is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected reuse contexts and container rules.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Each card is used only in the same single-column sizing context; there is no component reused in independently sized containers.
checkOutcomes.reason: Each card is used only in the same single-column sizing context; there is no component reused in independently sized containers.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused every interactive element and measured target boxes and outlines.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary controls are 370x56 CSS px but all four compute outline:none when focused.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewport, headings, labels, and visual hierarchy.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The H1 explains this is the BlackToon URL page and the first card presents a prominent primary destination action.

checkOutcomes.method: Followed the primary destination URL in a mobile browser.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first “바로가기” href resolves and the destination loads usable content, completing the hub’s primary hand-off.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated to a deliberately invalid path and inspected response behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The invalid path silently renders the same redirected homepage with no error explanation or recovery state.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse, trace, and layout observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 1.8 s; trace LCP is 1.70 s, TBT 36 ms, and layout CLS is 0.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts at mobile and desktop sizes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both layout captures report CLS 0 with no shift entries; the page has no images.

checkOutcomes.method: Recorded a performance trace and long-task observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace reports one 86 ms long task and 36 ms total blocking time, proportionate to the simple load.

checkOutcomes.method: Combined HAR initiator/priority data, DOM resource attributes, and Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 301 costs an estimated 820 ms and full Bootstrap is a confirmed VeryHigh-priority parser stylesheet; analytics is async and was not misclassified as blocking.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse unused-code audits and inspected HAR weight.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 23 KiB unused CSS and 68 KiB unused JS; GTM is 166,674 transferred bytes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe and inspected interactive elements and images.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All six controls are native named anchors, no images require alt text, and axe reports no name/role/label violation.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe color contrast analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Four card paragraphs measure 3.97:1 against white, below WCAG AA 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe, inspected heading order, and focused controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page jumps H1 to H3, and the four primary anchors have no visible focus outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop/mobile typography and clipping.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body and heading text remain readable, centered within bounded cards, with no clipping or cramped mobile wrapping.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked viewport policy, mobile reflow, targets, and media.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport allows scaling, mobile has no horizontal overflow, all primary targets are 56 px tall, and no media needs captions.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices and load probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scores 1.0 and reports no console-error audit failure.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected document primitives and Lighthouse code diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid and there are no images, but a one-template page ships 23 KiB estimated unused Bootstrap CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices and inspected load-time behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Best-practices scores 1.0; no permission prompts, paste blockers, or runtime deprecation failures were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected raw and rendered metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has a descriptive Korean title and meta description, both present in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchors, viewport, and robots.txt.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links have real hrefs, viewport metadata exists, and robots permits search, but four distinct primary links all say “바로가기”.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected HTTP chain, canonical markup, robots, and sitemap.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The input host redirects to another domain, no canonical link is present, and the requested host sitemap returns 403.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected JSON-LD and social preview tags.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata describes this public BlackToon link service.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers, cookies, mixed-resource, and secrets probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used and no insecure cookies or secrets were found, but all baseline security headers are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured trackers and HAR.
checkOutcomes.evidence: GTM and Google Analytics run on load; five of six requests and 194,421 bytes are third-party relative to the requested host.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected load behavior, DOM, and scripts for prompts/auth.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page requests no browser permissions and provides no authentication surface, so passkeys or auth handling do not apply.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page requests no browser permissions and provides no authentication surface, so passkeys or auth handling do not apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected final-document security headers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking defense, CSP, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw HTML with rendered DOM and no-JS crawler view.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability reports 100% raw/rendered content coverage, no JS shell, and matching crawler/browser views.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the static runtime, async dependencies, and viewport edges.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no menus/overlays or conditional async UI; its native links and static cards remain intact at mobile and desktop sizes.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected manifest and service-worker registration surface.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is a small public redirect/link page rather than an app; installability and an offline app shell are not proportionate to its purpose.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a small public redirect/link page rather than an app; installability and an offline app shell are not proportionate to its purpose.

checkOutcomes.method: Tested an invalid route and HTTP responses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: An unknown path silently redirects to the homepage rather than returning a useful 404 recovery state.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared declared language with rendered content and inspected CSS directionality.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Korean page declares html lang=en; Bootstrap also contributes many physical-direction rules, though the authored single-column layout is LTR-neutral.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered content and scripts for locale-sensitive values.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page displays no dates, numbers, currencies, durations, calendars, or locale-sensitive input.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page displays no dates, numbers, currencies, durations, calendars, or locale-sensitive input.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered content and scripts for time concepts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page contains no times, events, schedules, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page contains no times, events, schedules, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive data.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed the hub screenshot, links, and load behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited hub has no consent wall, forced continuity, hidden pricing, disguised ads, or confirmshaming; links are presented as links.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM for forms and validation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no forms or user-entered values to validate.
checkOutcomes.reason: There are no forms or user-entered values to validate.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM for form inputs and autocomplete.
checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no input fields or autofill-relevant tasks.
checkOutcomes.reason: There are no input fields or autofill-relevant tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the audited hub for checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, and account flows.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited hub has no commercial commitment, account, authentication, or cancellation flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited hub has no commercial commitment, account, authentication, or cancellation flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image audit and HAR asset inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page contains no img elements or decorative image payloads; only a 788-byte favicon is transferred.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured network and main-thread work.
checkOutcomes.evidence: An automatic analytics page-view loads a 166,674-byte script for a tiny static link hub, while Lighthouse estimates 68 KiB of JS unused.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured third-party bytes and tracker origins.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 194,421 of 194,824 transferred bytes, dominated by GTM; there is no media whose value offsets this cost.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected source/DOM and assessed site purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This static link directory exposes no transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP; crawlable native links are sufficient for agents.
checkOutcomes.reason: This static link directory exposes no transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP; crawlable native links are sufficient for agents.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected source/DOM and assessed site purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no summarisation, generation, or language-model task where on-device inference would improve the experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: The page has no summarisation, generation, or language-model task where on-device inference would improve the experience.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon plus interaction inventory and heap methodology review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This static one-shot page has no representative open/close, route-and-back, editor, or feed interaction to repeat ten times without fabricating a test.
checkOutcomes.reason: This static one-shot page has no representative open/close, route-and-back, editor, or feed interaction to repeat ten times without fabricating a test.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured and read a heap summary.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded page uses 4,731,679 bytes of V8 self size across 110,130 nodes, proportionate to a static page plus analytics.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected single-state heap constructors and the static interaction model.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appears among retained constructor populations; the page has no dynamic DOM lifecycle or repeating interaction that would accumulate listeners/timers.

principleOutcomes.reason: This static link directory has no meaningful agent-tool or on-device-inference surface.

paths.description: Requested homepage alias and its canonical redirect target; represents the site’s only same-site page/template.
Followed the first and primary outbound destination to verify the link hub completes its core hand-off; destination content itself was not audited.
Deliberately unknown path used to inspect HTTP/not-found recovery behavior.
No other same-site archetypes exist. Twitter, Naver, Kakao, and the linked destination’s internal templates were excluded because they are third-party sites outside this host audit.

findings.summary: The fixed palette does not respond to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop captures under default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are pixel-identical; the computed colorScheme is "normal" and the white cards remain fixed white.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and express page/card/text colors with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme query so both modes remain intentional.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on all four primary destination buttons.
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused each large “바로가기” anchor and computed outline-style:none and outline-width:0px for all four.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a clearly contrasting :focus-visible outline with adequate offset; do not remove the browser outline unless replacing it with an equally visible indicator.

findings.summary: Unknown paths silently become the homepage instead of explaining the recovery.
findings.evidence: Navigating to a deliberately missing path produced the same homepage screenshot and redirect chain, with no not-found message, retry, or route explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 for unknown paths with a concise explanation and a link back to the canonical address page; preserve the homepage redirect only for known aliases.

findings.summary: The alias redirect and blocking full Bootstrap stylesheet delay an otherwise tiny page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 820 ms redirect savings; HAR records the 301 plus a VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted 24,210-byte Bootstrap stylesheet, and Lighthouse flags render blocking and document latency.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the canonical page directly where possible, or keep one fast redirect, and replace full Bootstrap with the small critical styles this one-template page actually uses.

findings.summary: Unused framework CSS and analytics JavaScript dominate the minimal page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 23 KiB unused CSS and 68 KiB unused JavaScript; HAR shows Google Tag Manager at 166,674 of 194,824 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship page-specific CSS instead of the full framework and remove or defer analytics unless measurement is necessary and consented.

findings.summary: Card descriptions fail WCAG AA text contrast.
findings.evidence: axe reports all four #7c8085-on-white card paragraphs at 3.97:1, below the required 4.5:1 for 16 px normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the card description text to a token that reaches at least 4.5:1 against white, then re-run axe in normal and high-contrast conditions.

findings.summary: The heading hierarchy skips level two.
findings.evidence: DOM and axe show one H1 followed directly by four H3 card titles; axe flags heading-order.
findings.suggestedFix: Use H2 for the four top-level card headings, preserving a sequential H1 to H2 document outline.

findings.summary: Every primary link has the same generic “바로가기” text.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains four distinct external destinations whose visible and accessible names are all “바로가기”, so link lists lack destination context.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each link a destination-specific name, such as “블랙툰 최신 주소 열기” and “블랙툰 트위터 열기”.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals do not clearly connect the requested alias to the rendered domain.
findings.evidence: The requested domain 301s to blacktoonurl.net, the rendered document has no rel=canonical, and /sitemap.xml on the requested host returns a Cloudflare 403.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a canonical link for the rendered page and a reachable sitemap on the canonical host; keep alias redirects consistent with that canonical URL.

findings.summary: The public link hub has no social preview or structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD despite the page describing the BlackToon link service.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata and minimal schema.org Organization or WebSite JSON-LD matching the visible content.

findings.summary: The rendered page lacks baseline browser security headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on the final document.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive CSP with frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy at the canonical origin.

findings.summary: Analytics runs on load and carries disproportionate privacy and resource cost.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence identifies Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; HAR shows five of six requests and 194,421 of 194,824 bytes as third-party relative to the requested origin, including an automatic page_view.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove analytics if it is not essential; otherwise use a minimal, privacy-preserving measurement setup loaded only under an appropriate consent and retention policy.

findings.summary: The Korean page is incorrectly declared as English.
findings.evidence: The rendered content, title, headings, and actions are Korean, but the DOM probe reports html lang="en".
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang="ko" (and retain the default LTR direction); use logical properties for authored directional spacing when revising the stylesheet.

taskList.title: Add a baseline security-header policy at the canonical origin
Restore visible focus, fix contrast, and correct heading/language semantics
Remove full Bootstrap and minimise or remove analytics
Clarify link names and publish coherent canonical, sitemap, and share metadata
Make the fixed palette respond to color-scheme preferences
Return a useful 404 state for unknown paths
